title: Correct final B value
description: Essential Criteria: The student's final answer for the magnetic induction intensity B must be 2 T (or equivalent with correct units).

title: Force balance equation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly set up the static equilibrium condition, relating the magnetic force to the component of gravity along the incline.

title: Ampere's force law application
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the formula for the magnetic force on a current-carrying conductor, F = BIL.

title: Free-body diagram or force resolution
description: Optional Criteria: The student includes a clear free-body diagram or explicitly resolves the gravitational force into components relative to the inclined rods.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional Criteria: The student demonstrates that the units in their calculation (N, A, m, T) are consistent and lead to the correct unit for B.

title: Incorrect force component
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student incorrectly uses Mg, Mg cosθ, or Mg sinθ as the balancing force instead of Mg tanθ, indicating a misunderstanding of the force geometry.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student makes an error in the direction of the magnetic force or current relative to the field, leading to an incorrect force balance equation.
